rubric: explains only the first true branch runs
mentions elif is the Python spelling

exercises.title: The default that accumulates
exercises.prompt: Calling collect twice gives ['a', 'b'] instead of ['a'] then ['b']. Fix it so each call starts empty.
exercises.code:
def collect(item, bucket=[]):
    bucket.append(item)
    return bucket

print(collect('a'))
print(collect('b'))
exercises.starter_code:
def collect(item, bucket=None):
    if bucket is None:
        bucket = []
    bucket.append(item)
    return bucket

print(collect('a'))
print(collect('b'))
